answer: In an agent economy trading mesa surveys, relic appraisals, and onyx valuations, voting power is proportional to tokens locked in escrow, not the number of accounts. Splitting one deposit among a thousand fake agents gives the attacker no extra voting weight. To gain influence, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens; signed votes for conflicting outcomes in the same round provide evidence that triggers confiscation of the offending stake.
